changelog:
Initial release — read-only IPFS client skill

- Enables fetching files, inspecting metadata, exploring DAGs, and resolving IPNS names via local node or public gateways.
- Strictly read-only: no publishing, pinning, or state-changing network operations.
- Prefers local ipfs CLI if available; falls back to HTTP gateway access (curl).
- Includes quick reference for common queries (file fetch, IPNS resolve, DAG/stat inspection).
- Documents safe usage patterns, tool detection, troubleshooting tips, and Web3 integration scenarios.
summary: Read-only IPFS queries — fetch files, inspect metadata, explore DAGs, and resolve IPNS names via local or public gateways
